disclosure: the orchestrator's end-of-run console summary (alert counts per phase) for the attack runs had been printed before the evaluator was fixed; the criteria and parameters were fixed before any run and were not changed afterwards.

changes.what: one key path, in the validity gate prereg_matches_run_spec; no criterion, threshold, window, parameter or verdict logic was touched
changes.why: scripts/ardupilot/evaluate_ap_attack.py raised KeyError: 'attack_spec' at first use (it looked the attack spec up at the top level of the pre-registration, which stores it at attack.spec). All three attack runs had already completed; no evaluation output of any kind existed when the fix was made (the evaluator crashed before writing anything).

changes.what: output label only: control_arm.alerts_whole_flight_inflight_phases renamed alerts_whole_flight_all_phases (+ a note). The value (5 in every run) counts ALL alerts in the clean replay, including the 5 start-up alerts, because phases are not labelled there; the old name wrongly implied in-flight.
changes.why: found while reading the first successful evaluation; no criterion, threshold, window, parameter or verdict changed, and the evaluation was re-run afterwards with identical verdicts
changes.order_note: the evaluation outputs were regenerated in the same step as the edit; no evaluation output from before this label change exists

changes.what: added optional `--harness {standard,passive}` (default standard = the harness the P2 runs used), `--monitor-heartbeat` (passive only), and one extra fetched file name (`monitor_events.jsonl`). Default behaviour is unchanged; no metric, gate or output field of the standard path changed.
changes.why: deployment-preparation experiment on a parameter-configured, receive-only monitor port (docs/ONBOARD_DEPLOYMENT.md). It is separate from the registered P2 and is not scored by the pre-registration.

changes.what: post-review hardening after independent code and security review (no criterion, threshold, window, parameter or attack logic touched; the detectors, fusion, configs, attack, collector and ap_netns_run.sh remain byte-identical to the registered versions; run_ap_sitl_ids.py, evaluate_ap_attack.py, frame_pipe.py and frame_tap.py changed and are listed below)
changes.evaluate_ap_attack.py: added validity gates: pipe reader had no error, phase events present, attack window inside the link span; and an INVALID outcome when the control window or the pre-onset in-flight set is EMPTY (C1/B1 would otherwise pass by absence of data). Re-run on all three attack runs: verdicts, criteria results and first alerts unchanged (15 gates, all true); evaluation.json files regenerated from the hardened evaluator.
changes.run_ap_sitl_ids.py: --name allow-list + shlex.quote + tar member allow-list/size cap (security review); a wall-clock/producer-death watchdog so a run with no frames cannot hang (code review H1/H1b); the monitor mode (receive_only_monitor / monitor_transmits_heartbeat / harness) is recorded in summary.json; WSL follow-up calls no longer abort a finished run. Verified on a fresh full flight (3,660 frames, byte-identical, 0 in-flight alerts).
changes.frame_pipe.py / frame_tap.py: a v2 record shorter than its header is corrupt (was reachable as IndexError in the tap); a torn length header is an error not a clean EOF; error is recorded before eof; the tap parses headers inside its fail-open try and closes tlogs even if the inner close raises. 4 new tests.
